description: This file defines a class MacroTreeRenderer that implements the TreeStringRenderer interface. It provides methods for rendering tree structures with macros using the FreeMarker templating engine, including rendering nodes, labels, links, images, and boundary comments in a tree widget for the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MacroTreeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that uses FreeMarker macros to render hierarchical tree structures in OFBiz, supporting boundary comments, node rendering, links, images, and labels, with macro execution and template handling.

methods.name: MacroTreeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that loads the macro library template and initializes the FreeMarker environment for macro rendering.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Executes a given macro string by creating a temporary template and including it in the environment.

methods.name: renderBeginningBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders the starting boundary comment macro for a widget, useful for delineating sections in the rendered output.

methods.name: renderEndingBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders the ending boundary comment macro for a widget.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a tree node, including boundary comments and expansion/collapse controls.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a tree node, including boundary comments if it is the root node.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Renders the last element indicator for a node if processing continues for children.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders a label for a tree node, with specified id, style, and text.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink with optional image, handling internal, content, and external URLs.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image with its source determined by URL mode, and constructs the appropriate URL.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Returns the screen string renderer that can be used for rendering screens, if available in the context.
